method.geometry: exact-head Chromium SVG getBBox ratios against qa/reference/brand-reference-contract.json
method.visual: exact-head Playwright matrices reviewed at 256, 192, 128, 96, 64, 56, 44, 32, 24 and 16 pixels
method.motion: one exported frame-rate-invariant controller, deterministic 15-144Hz simulation, exact-head Chromium trajectory sampling with interpolated crossings and interval-normalized smoothness
method.siteBreadth: production sitemap-derived Chromium crawl plus utility, legacy redirect and 404 scenarios
method.rule: green CI proves stability, not reference similarity

visualEvidence.finding: production and v19.11 remain substantially darker and much more regular than the canonical electrical field; v19.11 gains mass but introduces an armor-like horizontal cowl and still undersizes the face cavern

architecture.controllerOwnership: src/components/brandMotionFrameInvariant.ts owns the only requestAnimationFrame loop and spring integration
architecture.framePolicy: consume real wall-clock time up to 100ms in stable substeps no larger than 1/60s; do not discard elapsed time
architecture.clockPolicy: reset the integration clock whenever RAF reaches a settled state
architecture.reducedMotion: remove all depth transforms and cancel controller ownership

springSimulation.rule: all rates use the same spring constants; bounded substeps make wall-clock convergence independent of sparse RAF cadence

exactHeadBrowser.head: 018086fbd4d73a0fca973b480b60dcf3b3596f2e
exactHeadBrowser.timingMeasurement: 0.5%, 95% and 120ms values are linearly interpolated between real samples rather than assigned to the nearest sparse sample
exactHeadBrowser.smoothnessMeasurement: both absolute observed displacement and displacement normalized to an equivalent 60Hz interval are bounded

blockingDefectsFound: translations were fixed pixels across transformed 48, 64 and 96 pixel marks, so relative depth changed with rendered size
the original settling constants and strict numerical epsilon retained an invisible RAF tail beyond 1.2 seconds on a throttled CI renderer
the original 32ms one-step clamp discarded elapsed wall-clock time when RAF was sparse, making entry speed depend on runner load
the old browser test treated a 50-100ms sampling gap as one 16.7ms frame and used nearest-sample timing, producing false smoothness and convergence failures
motionEvidence.correction: spring-awakening-v5 keeps the established visual spring constants, scales translations by the rendered box, consumes elapsed time through bounded 60Hz-or-smaller substeps, resets its clock on every settled stop and is measured with interpolated timing crossings plus interval-normalized and absolute smoothness gates

siteRouteEvidence.head: 018086fbd4d73a0fca973b480b60dcf3b3596f2e
checks: main content, primary heading, header, footer and brand shell
siteRouteEvidence.productionDefectFoundAndFixed: PoetsPage inherited the root canonical because it did not own route SEO metadata; /poets now declares its title, description and canonical through the shared useSeo hook
siteRouteEvidence.antiHack: canonical routes come from the generated production sitemap; the crawler cannot be kept green by manually omitting a newly added poet, essay or track

blockingDeviations: production hood width is below the reference contract and the face cavern is too narrow
v19.11 and v19.17 broaden the hood but still fail face-cavern width and hood-height ratios

the cowl remains cleaner and more horizontal than the crushed gathered cloth in the reference
the aura remains too regular and mirror-like; reference irregularity is materially higher
at 24 and 16 pixels the identity collapses primarily to a cyan hood arc rather than a broad black cavern and heavy shoulder mass
